chromis__align_intrascan.pro


Routines

top source chromis::align_intrascan

CHROMIS pipeline

chromis::align_intrascan, choose_states=choose_states [, /limb_data], momfbddir=momfbddir [, /overwrite], state1=state1, state2=state2

Measure image shift between any two restored images from the same scan, to be used for alignment of crispex cubes.

By default wideband and narrowband continuum are used.

Keywords

choose_states
limb_data in optional type=boolean

Set for data where the limb is in the FOV. Makes sure to use a subfield on the disk for alignment.

momfbddir
overwrite in optional type=boolean

Set this to overwrite existing files.

state1
state2
